name: Forgewell Factions
description:
FORGEWELL FACTIONS

A Minecraft Bedrock factions server where there's always something to fight for.

Tired of survival worlds that die after two weeks? Forgewell gives you a reason to log back in tomorrow. Build a faction, make rivals, chase events and work your way up from your first stack of iron to the top of the leaderboards.

HOW TO JOIN

How to join the forgewell factions server!

PC/Mobile 

add the server to your server list!

IP: play.forgewellfactions.com

Port: 19132

Console 

Add JoinLunarMC on Minecraft

and join their world! 

FACTIONS AND CONQUEST

- Create a faction with your friends, claim land and build your base

- Upgrade your claims and grow your faction's power

- Share money through your faction bank

- Battle for the hill in King of the Hill. The winning faction gets $50,000 in its bank, and every member online gets a Forgefire key

- No faction? You can still take the hill on your own for $15,000 and a key

- Capture outposts around the map. They pay into your faction bank for as long as you hold them, so expect a fight

- Compete in the weekly faction race. First place wins $150,000 and a Forgefire key for every member online, with $75,000 for second and $40,000 for third

EVENTS ANYONE CAN WIN

New events start regularly, and many of them need no faction and no PvP, so new players have a real shot.

- Piñata Party: chase it around spawn while it runs from you, and hit it until it bursts with loot. Whoever hits it most wins Ember keys

- Treasure Hunt: chests are hidden all around spawn, each paying $500. Find the most to win up to $10,000 and 2 keys

- Mini Contests: mine, chop, farm or kill the most in 15 minutes to win up to $15,000 and 2 keys

- Drop Parties: items rain down at spawn for a full minute, with fireworks, for everyone to grab

- Supply Drops: a crate falls somewhere in the wild. Race there, fight for it and take the rewards

- Wandering Black Market: rare items for sale, but only for a limited time
